titleEn: Sign in with the Ebda AI Studio account

en: How do I sign in to Ebda Chat?

steps: Use the same Ebda AI Studio account as Ebda Store
You land in the inbox for your store
edgeCases: Sign-in error codes: denied, state, nonce, token, discovery, missing_id_token, claims (SignInError screen lists a reason)
Accounts service unreachable: gate shows retry
Session revoked: writes answer 403 session_revoked, sign in again
Arabic/RTL: phone numbers, URLs and API keys stay LTR inside RTL text
Mobile: rail collapses to a bottom/side nav; the orders pane opens as a sheet
assistantNote: Assistant can explain only; it never handles credentials
